summary: Retrospective per-word annotation of Bea’s functional cup design, accidental dent, considered alternatives, adaptation, drying and two distinct firings, birthday gift and observed use.

ambiguities.issue: Three-week making activity is a summary; the current clay lump’s exact earlier history is not narrated.
A wide handle is present later, but its creation or attachment is not narrated. No construction event is invented.

The source calls the next kiln firing the last before the birthday, yet narrates a second firing before the gift. Scheduled-event identity and workshop schedule are unresolved; two actual firings remain separate and no extra dates are invented.

Handle faces the hollow, opposite the thumb rest is geometrically underspecified. Preserve the wording without inventing a measured orientation or separating the same indentation into an extra object.
Workshop testing table and pickup table have separate provisional identities; the story does not establish that they are the same table.
Finger inspection is shown, but a conclusive all-around wall-thickness finding is not stated.
Water test precedes a tea-filled cup; emptying water and filling tea are unreported transitions, not separate invented events.

Final cup is found on the bench; a table is described beneath it; Grandpa is then drinking while kneeling. Bench/table layout, pickup and intermediate movements are unspecified. Preserve endpoints and do not fabricate transitions.
Borrowing and later thanks for lending refer to one loan from opposite participant perspectives.
Thumb wanted to go is a personified evaluation of fit by Grandpa, not an autonomous thumb mental state.

feature_gaps.meaning: ergonomic fit and comfort for a specific body part and grip
feature_gaps.resolution: Use existing grasping/supporting/contact fields plus a narrow legacy fit description. A future typed ergonomic_fit bundle could bind person, body part, object feature and condition without diagnosing pain or general usability.
Event identities, state changes and temporal relations suffice here; no new manufacture-stage field is proposed solely for pottery.

prompt_feedback: Quote summaries of a prior multi-action adaptation need a stable episode or explicit supporting-event links, without creating a second actual repair.
Before selecting causality, distinguish a strongly implied accident mechanism from explicit causal wording; candidate status can retain a useful uncertain link.
Scope a possible negated outcome under its modal: might not stick is not observed failure.
Keep source schedule inconsistencies and layout gaps visible rather than silently repairing them with domain knowledge.
coverage_notes: All 709 words have explicit contextual POS and lemma choices. All 1,024 catalog definitions and v2 examples were read. Every one of the 29 assembled paragraphs was read against the source and repaired. Full-story retrospective annotations retain no causal-prefix filter; gaps remain synthetic and lossless. Shape validation is supplemented by manual semantic review.
